task.title: Real-time Sync Execution Engine with Live Monitoring Dashboard
task.description: Build the core sync execution engine that processes the configured mappings and moves data between systems, along with a real-time monitoring dashboard. The execution engine should: (1) Parse mapping configurations from localStorage and execute sync jobs based on schedules (immediate, scheduled, or manual trigger). (2) Implement field-level transformations (formulas, lookups, custom functions) with error handling and rollback capability. (3) Apply validation rules before sync and log validation failures with detailed error messages. (4) Execute conflict resolution strategies (source wins, target wins, most recent, manual review) when duplicate/conflicting records are detected. (5) Generate sync logs with record-level success/failure tracking, timestamp, duration, and error details. (6) Implement batch processing for large datasets with configurable batch sizes and rate limiting. The monitoring dashboard (SyncMonitorView) should display: (1) Live sync status widget showing currently running jobs with progress bars and record counts (processed/total/failed). (2) Recent sync history table with columns for mapping name, start time, duration, status, records synced, errors, and 'View Details' action. (3) Detailed sync log viewer modal showing record-by-record results with expandable error messages and field-level transformation traces. (4) Sync metrics cards showing total syncs today, success rate, average duration, and total records synced. (5) Manual trigger button for each mapping with confirmation dialog. (6) Real-time status updates using polling (simulate WebSocket with 3-second intervals). (7) Export sync logs to CSV functionality. (8) Filter controls for date range, mapping name, and status. Store sync execution logs in localStorage with automatic cleanup of logs older than 30 days. Use the existing CSS framework for consistent styling and add loading spinners, success/error toast notifications, and empty states for no sync history.
task.rationale: The configuration interface is complete, but without an execution engine, users cannot actually sync data — making the entire system non-functional. This is the critical path feature that delivers core value. Real-time monitoring is essential for users to verify syncs are working, diagnose issues, and build confidence in the system. This transforms the application from a configuration tool into a working sync platform. It also establishes the data flow architecture and logging infrastructure that all future features (webhooks, API integrations, alerts) will depend on.

issues: Critical: Incomplete/truncated code - HTML missing closing tags (, , , , ) and JavaScript function cut off mid-execution (ModalManager.showTriggerDialog ends with 'getMap...'). Code cannot execute in current state.

Security: Multiple XSS vulnerabilities - Utils.getStatusBadge() returns unsanitized HTML, no Content Security Policy, external resources loaded without SRI, error traces displayed in UI leak system information, localStorage parsed without validation/error handling.

Accessibility failures: No ARIA labels, keyboard navigation broken (modal has no trap/escape handler), color-only status indicators violate WCAG, table lacks semantic markup (scope/headers/caption), no skip navigation or focus management.
data.feedback: MUST FIX: 1) Complete the code - add all missing closing HTML tags and finish the truncated JavaScript function. 2) Implement XSS protection: sanitize all dynamic HTML (especially Utils.getStatusBadge), add CSP meta tag, use textContent instead of innerHTML where possible, wrap JSON.parse in try/catch. 3) Add input validation for date filters (ensure start < end). 4) Implement accessibility: add ARIA labels to interactive elements, add keyboard event handlers for modal (Escape to close, Tab trap), use both color AND text/icons for status, add table headers/scope attributes. 5) Add SRI hashes to Google Fonts link. 6) Consider masking sensitive error details from UI display. 7) Add authentication/rate limiting UI if this triggers server actions.

issues: CSP policy allows 'unsafe-inline' for scripts and styles - this completely undermines XSS protection. Remove 'unsafe-inline' and use nonces or hashes for inline scripts/styles, or move all scripts to external files.

Multiple critical accessibility violations: missing ARIA labels on navigation/buttons, color-only status indicators without text alternatives, progress bars without aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax, and modal focus trap missing. Add proper ARIA attributes and ensure keyboard navigation works correctly.
Code is incomplete with cut-off definitions (Modal.create() function and .record-he CSS class) making the implementation non-functional. Complete all code blocks before submission.
data.feedback: The dashboard has a good structural foundation but fails on security and accessibility. Priority fixes: (1) Remove CSP 'unsafe-inline' directives - externalize inline scripts or use nonces; (2) Add comprehensive ARIA labels (aria-label on all interactive elements, aria-live for status updates, aria-valuenow/min/max on progress bars); (3) Implement proper modal focus trapping using focusin/focusout event listeners; (4) Add text alternatives for color-coded statuses (use visually-hidden text or aria-label); (5) Complete the Modal.create() function and .record-he CSS; (6) Add error handling for localStorage quota exceeded exceptions; (7) Include prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable animations for accessibility; (8) Add input validation in Utils.formatDuration() for negative/NaN values. The incomplete code sections indicate this was not tested and is not production-ready.

issues: Critical CSP violation: Entire <style> block with inline styles violates 'style-src self' directive, making the application non-functional under strict CSP. Must extract all CSS to external stylesheet and remove 'unsafe-inline' from CSP policy.

Severe accessibility violations: Navigation lacks ARIA labels/roles, modal missing keyboard trap/focus management, status indicators use color-only differentiation without text/icons for colorblind users, progress bars lack ARIA attributes, and forms have no label associations - violates WCAG 2.1 Level A/AA standards.

Security vulnerabilities: Modal.create() accepts unsanitized content parameter creating XSS risk, no CSRF protection on manual sync trigger, script nonce='app-core-2024' is hardcoded string rather than cryptographically generated per-request value, and external font CDN resources introduce privacy/tracking concerns.
data.feedback: 1. IMMEDIATE FIX - Move all inline styles to external 'styles.css' file and update CSP to strict 'style-src self' only. 2. Add proper semantic HTML: wrap navigation in <nav role='navigation' aria-label='Main'>, add <label> elements for all form inputs with for/id associations, add role='dialog' aria-modal='true' to modals with keyboard trap implementation. 3. Replace Modal innerHTML assignment with textContent or use DOMPurify library for sanitization. Add data-badge-text attributes to status badges with screen-reader-only spans. 4. Generate cryptographic nonces server-side and inject into both CSP header and script tags. 5. Implement skeleton loading states with aria-busy='true' during fetch operations. 6. Add :disabled, :focus-visible, and prefers-reduced-motion media queries. 7. Add CSRF token validation to sync trigger endpoint.

issues: CSP policy critically broken: 'style-src self' blocks Google Fonts stylesheet, 'script-src self' blocks inline scripts without nonces, and no integrity checks (SRI) on external resources - entire security header is counterproductive

Multiple XSS and injection vulnerabilities: formatTimestamp outputs unsanitized date strings to DOM, JSON.parse lacks error handling causing crashes on invalid localStorage data, CSRF token field empty with no server validation

Incomplete code artifacts and critical bugs: AppState object initialization cuts off mid-definition, setLoadingState function incomplete, trapFocus creates memory leaks by never removing listeners, generateId uses weak collision-prone timestamp+random logic
data.feedback: 1) Fix CSP: Add 'https://fonts.googleapis.com' to style-src, add nonces to inline scripts (e.g., <script nonce='{{csp_nonce}}'>), add integrity attributes to Google Fonts links. 2) Secure data handling: Wrap all JSON.parse in try-catch blocks, sanitize formatTimestamp output using textContent instead of innerHTML, implement server-side CSRF token generation/validation. 3) Complete implementations: Finish AppState initialization and setLoadingState function, add cleanup to trapFocus with removeEventListener on modal close, replace generateId with crypto.randomUUID() or server-generated IDs. 4) Add validation: Check filters.dateRange exists in ranges object before access, validate batchSize server-side, add null checks before all DOM manipulations. 5) Remove redundant CSRF storage (keep only AppState or sessionStorage, not both). Code is 70% complete but has critical security flaws and broken functionality that prevent production deployment.

blocking_issues: No keyboard navigation for modal close - users cannot press Escape to close modals
No focus trap in modal - keyboard users can tab outside the modal to underlying content
No ARIA labels on icon-only buttons (refresh, close) - screen readers cannot identify button purpose
Filter inputs lack associated labels using for/id attributes - screen readers cannot connect labels to inputs
Nav links use <a> tags with href='#' but JavaScript navigation - causes page jumps and breaks browser history
No ARIA live region for live sync status updates - screen readers won't announce status changes
Table lacks <caption> element - screen readers cannot identify table purpose
No loading states or disabled states on buttons during async operations - users may click multiple times
Sidebar hidden on mobile (<768px) with no alternative navigation - users cannot access other views
No skip navigation link for keyboard users to bypass sidebar
Color contrast issue: --text-tertiary (#94a3b8) on white background fails WCAG AA (3.8:1)
Filter toolbar label 'S' appears truncated in HTML - incomplete accessibility label
Modal missing aria-labelledby and aria-modal attributes
No ARIA live region for dynamic sync status updates - screen readers won't announce changes
Emoji icons (📊, 🔗, ⚙️, etc.) used without aria-hidden or text alternatives
No focus trap in modal - keyboard users can tab to background content
